name: Jakobsweg
description_md:
The Jakobsweg is a 32.0 km waymarked hiking route in Austria. Signposted as Jakobsweg Melk - Persenbeug, it has a difficulty of hard, derived from distance and ascent.

The walk includes 548 m of ascent and 569 m of descent. The walking time is about 9.5 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. It belongs to an international waymarked hiking network and passes Melk within 100 m.
